en.title: SoC Power Optimisation Engineer
en.description: Engineered SoC power optimizations across multiple platforms, with focus on deep sleep behaviors and measurable rail-level efficiency improvements.

list.title: Key Responsibilities:
items: Implemented low-power modes including Hibernate and DeepSleep.

Performed rail-level root cause analysis for system power anomalies.
Worked closely with validation teams to confirm power targets and stability under real workloads.
